label: Deleuze revitalized Spinozan univocity of being and immanence
description: Gilles Deleuze adopted Baruch Spinoza's insights and systematically extended them into new metaphysical, ethical, or epistemological domains.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Baruch Spinoza's perspective to Gilles Deleuze's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the Early Modern & Scientific across history into the Contemporary & Post-Structural.

label: Formulated and introduced Pantheism (Deus Sive Natura)
description: Baruch Spinoza formulated and introduced the concept of "Pantheism (Deus Sive Natura)", which became a seminal contribution in metaphysics philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in metaphysics.
historicalContext: Introduced during the Early Modern & Scientific as part of Baruch Spinoza's canonical writings.

label: Transformed Spinozist pantheistic naturalism into embodied, humanistic sensory materialism
description: Ludwig Feuerbach adopted Baruch Spinoza's insights and systematically extended them into new metaphysical, ethical, or epistemological domains.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Baruch Spinoza's perspective to Ludwig Feuerbach's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the Early Modern & Scientific across history into the 19th Century Divergences.
